spec.goal: Allow dragged-region frozen selections to be repositioned by dragging the bright selection area without resizing it.
success_criteria: In Frozen mode, a drag-region capture can be grabbed from inside the bright selected area and moved while keeping width and height unchanged.
The moved rect stays clamped to the frozen monitor bounds and the outside scrim updates continuously during the move.
Toolbar placement, scroll-preview placement, export cropping, and scroll-capture eligibility continue to key off the moved frozen capture rect without flashing or desynchronizing.
Clicks outside the bright region do not start a frozen move interaction and existing non-move frozen behavior remains unchanged.
constraints: Do not add resize handles or any size-changing behavior in this issue.
Do not expand the interaction across monitors; keep the moved rect on the existing frozen monitor only.
Preserve existing final-capture gating and dragged-region-only scroll-capture eligibility.
Follow repo-native verification via cargo make tasks before claiming completion.

tasks.title: Add frozen move interaction state and clamp helpers
tasks.objective: Represent the drag-to-move interaction separately from live drag selection and provide a deterministic way to clamp a fixed-size frozen capture rect within the active frozen monitor.
outputs: Frozen selection move state in the overlay session/runtime state
Helper(s) to detect in-rect presses and clamp fixed-size moved rects to the frozen monitor bounds
verification: Move helpers compile cleanly and leave live drag behavior isolated from frozen move behavior.

tasks.title: Route frozen pointer input to reposition the capture rect
tasks.objective: Start a move interaction only when pressing inside an eligible drag-region frozen selection, update the rect continuously while the pointer moves, and commit the new position on release.
outputs: Frozen pointer input path that repositions state.frozen_capture_rect without resizing it
Live toolbar/preview position updates driven by the moved rect when the toolbar is not manually dragged
verification: Dragging inside the bright frozen region updates the rect continuously and keeps it within monitor bounds.
Pointer updates outside the bright region do not begin a move interaction.

tasks.title: Cover the new interaction with focused regression tests
tasks.objective: Add tests that lock down frozen-region repositioning, clamping, and non-goal boundaries so future frozen-selection changes do not regress XY-155.
outputs: Regression tests for frozen move start gating, moved-rect updates, clamp behavior, and downstream rect consumers
verification: New XY-155 tests fail on missing behavior and pass once the implementation is in place.

tasks.title: Run repo-native verification and close out execution state
tasks.objective: Run the required repo gates on the final implementation state and record enough evidence to prepare the branch for commit/push later.
outputs: Updated plan runtime state reflecting what was completed this turn
